title: 第11章 迟来的回音第12章 周常委托完成
slug: 你好是寄往魔神堡垒的信吗
lines: 半天后，贫民窟劳动派遣中心门口。
行人们纷纷停下脚步，诧异地望向门外聚集的人群。
此起彼伏的啜泣声在空气中交织，仿佛一首悲伤的交响曲。
“你母亲的名字？25年前居住的家乡名字？“
希娅握着一封泛黄的信封，轻声询问眼前衣着朴素的女孩。
夕阳的余晖洒在她银色的长发上，映照出淡淡的红光。
女孩的身体微微颤抖，目光中带着几分恐惧。
小心翼翼地打量着眼前这位银发红瞳的精灵。
关于魔族的可怕传说在她脑海中不断闪现，让她几乎站立不稳。
“母亲的名字，25年前居住的家乡名字。“
希娅再次重复，声音轻柔得像一片羽毛。
“......耶尔·维姬......家乡是，摩罗城。“女孩的声音细若蚊吟。
“嗯，你确实是她的女儿。信给你。“希娅将信封递出。
女孩迅速抓过信封，像受惊的小鹿般缩回手，转身就跑。
她的脚步，在尘土飞扬的小巷中显得格外慌乱。
希娅轻轻叹了口气，银色的睫毛低垂。
她实在不明白，林鬼为什么非要让她来做这份工作。
以她半魔的身份，不把人吓跑就已经是万幸了。
“那个精灵姐姐！！谢谢！！“
门外忽然传来女孩清脆的喊声。
希娅愕然抬起头，只看到巷口扬起的尘土，在夕阳中闪闪发光。
人影早已消失不见。
她撇撇嘴，低声嘟囔。
“都道谢了，跑得倒挺快......“
说着说着，自己却忍不住笑了起来。
那笑容如同冰雪初融。
阳光穿透云层，不经意间撩动了不少旁观者的心弦。
“喂，希娅，你有没有跟她说，要她写封回信啊？“
刚刚从银行换了500银币回来的林鬼。
一边将两枚银币递给报信的人，一边转头向希娅问道。
他的额头上，还带着奔波后的细密汗珠。
“呃——忘了。“希娅不好意思地摸了摸鼻尖。
“那还不赶紧去追！“
在林鬼连声催促下，希娅不情不愿地走出了派遣中心。
希娅在城邦上飞跃
她一个轻巧的蹬踏，借着错落木屋的凸起处跃上贫民窟的最高点。
一座废弃警戒塔的顶端。
风扬起她银色的发丝，在夕阳中划出优美的弧线。
右手搭在额前，希娅红宝石般的眼眸中流光微动。
不一会儿，她就在不远处的一条小巷中找到了那个女孩的身影。
从派遣中心出来后，阿妮紧紧攥着那封信，嘴角控制不住地上扬。
她在夕阳的金晖中蹦跳着前进，像一只欢快的小鹿。
content_en:
Half a day later, at the entrance of the slum labor dispatch center.
Pedestrians stopped one after another and looked at the crowd gathered outside the door in surprise.
One after another sobs intertwined in the air, like a sad symphony.
"What's your mother's name? The name of your hometown where you lived 25 years ago?"
Sia held a yellowed envelope and asked the plainly dressed girl in front of her softly.
The afterglow of the setting sun shone on her long silver hair, reflecting a faint red light.
The girl's body trembled slightly, and there was a bit of fear in her eyes.
He carefully looked at the silver-haired and red-eyed elf in front of him.
The terrifying legends about the demons kept flashing in her mind, making her almost unsteady.
"My mother's name, the name of my hometown where I lived 25 years ago."
Shia repeated again, her voice as soft as a feather.
"...Yel Vicki...My hometown is Moro City." The girl's voice was as thin as a mosquito's moan.
"Well, you are indeed her daughter. This letter is for you." Sia handed out the envelope.
The girl quickly grabbed the envelope, retracted her hand like a frightened deer, turned around and ran away.
Her footsteps seemed particularly flustered in the dusty alley.
Shia sighed softly, her silver eyelashes lowered.
She really didn't understand why Lin Gui had to let her do this job.
As a half-demon, she was lucky enough not to scare people away.
"That elf sister!! Thank you!!"
Suddenly, a girl's crisp shout came from outside the door.
Shia raised her head in shock, only to see the dust rising from the alley, shining in the sunset.
The figure had long since disappeared.
She curled her lips and muttered softly.
"Thank you all, I ran pretty fast..."
As he spoke, he couldn't help but laugh.
That smile was like the first melting of ice and snow.
The sun penetrated the clouds and inadvertently touched the heartstrings of many onlookers.
"Hey, Sia, have you told her that you want her to write a reply?"
Lin Gui just returned from the bank in exchange for 500 silver coins.
While handing two silver coins to the messenger, he turned to Sia and asked.
On his forehead, there were still beads of sweat from running around.
"Uh--I forgot." Sia touched the tip of her nose sheepishly.
"Then why don't you hurry up and chase after me!"
Under Lin Gui's repeated urging, Xia reluctantly walked out of the dispatch center.
Shia leaps across the city-state
With a light step, she jumped up to the highest point of the slum through the protrusions of scattered wooden houses.
The top of an abandoned guard tower.
The wind lifted her silver hair, drawing beautiful arcs in the sunset.
Putting her right hand on her forehead, Shia's ruby-like eyes moved slightly.
After a while, she found the girl's figure in an alley not far away.
After coming out of the dispatch center, Ani clutched the letter tightly and couldn't help but raise the corners of her mouth.
She jumped forward in the golden glow of the setting sun, like a cheerful deer.
